Create ONE revised version of image 1 in a 16:9 landscape frame, representing a carefully hand-drawn native 640x360 pixel-art upgrade. Keep the existing view, camera, horizon, curving road shape, road width and number of lanes, red car footprint, two seated people, sea on the right, hillside on the left, background mountains, daylight and sun placement. Primary change: increase the actual graphical DETAIL at a finer but still very visible, crisp and consistent pixel grid, not merely smooth or upscale the old pixels. Draw the red car with more detailed angular pixel clusters, recognisable tail lamps, rear grille and vents, body highlight bands, tyres, readable seats and the couple. Keep its sporty unbranded design and rear viewpoint. Improve the palm foliage with individually readable pixel-cluster fronds, shaded trunks and contact shadows. Give the beach, verge, guardrail and sea finer structured detail, readable post spacing, a few directional water glints and distinct calm wave bands. Draw at the equivalent of a 640x360 logical pixel grid; if output must be larger, show crisp nearest-neighbour-like enlarged logical pixels.
